_comment: Customs codes used to measure EU-bound trade in CBAM goods. Feeds eu_export_share. Read at runtime; never hardcode (SKDM_TURKIYE.md section 7).

meta.authoritative_source: Regulation (EU) 2023/956, ANNEX I — Goods and greenhouse gases covered
meta.scope_warning: The codes below are HS2/HS4 AGGREGATES, not the CN8 list in Annex I. Annex I could not be retrieved in machine-readable form at the retrieval date. Aggregates OVERSTATE CBAM scope: HS chapter 72 contains steel products that Annex I does not list, and chapter 76 likewise for aluminium. Any eu_export_share computed from these codes is an UPPER BOUND on the true CBAM-covered share.
meta.action_required: Transcribe the CN8 codes from ANNEX I of the Official Journal text, replace the `codes` arrays below, and set scope_status to `annex_i_verified`. Until then no figure derived from this file may be published.

trade_source.dataset: DS-045409 — EU trade since 1988 by HS2-4-6 and CN8

dimension_codes.flow: 1 (IMPORT — i.e. EU imports FROM Türkiye, which is Türkiye's export TO the EU)

trade_source.unit_note: QUANTITY_IN_100KG is in hundreds of kilograms. Divide by 10 to obtain tonnes.

cement.description: Portland cement, aluminous cement, slag cement and clinkers.
cement.annex_i_note: Annex I also lists 2507 00 80 (kaolinic clays). Not included in this provisional aggregate.

iron-and-steel.description: Chapter 72 (iron and steel) plus the chapter 73 headings for downstream articles that Annex I brings into scope.
iron-and-steel.annex_i_note: Chapter 72 as a whole overstates scope: Annex I excludes certain ferro-alloys and scrap. Narrow this to CN8 before publication.

aluminum.annex_i_note: Annex I lists specific 7601/7603-7616 headings rather than the whole chapter. Narrow before publication.

out_of_scope.fertilisers: Covered by CBAM (Annex I) but excluded from this project: no open source publishes Turkish fertiliser-production facilities. See ROADMAP.md.
out_of_scope.electricity: Covered by CBAM. Excluded by choice: Turkish electricity exports to the EU are marginal.
out_of_scope.hydrogen: Covered by CBAM. Excluded by choice: negligible volume.
